review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This full-time, on-site role in Cairo, Egypt involves overseeing the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong .NET development skills (e.g., C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework) and solid experience with object-oriented programming and RESTful APIs. Candidates should possess practical expertise in AI and LLM technologies, including working with major AI platforms (such as Azure OpenAI or similar), prompt engineering, model integration, and basic understanding of machine learning concepts. Candidates should possess experience with databases and cloud environments, such as SQL Server or other relational databases, and hands-on work with cloud providers (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and CI/CD pipelines.
